nodes.title: Pod-to-wing bond: flight/ground envelope and crash
nodes.equation: loads moved from C1's point (pod centre, base) to the bond centroid: M' = M + (r_ref - r_c) x F; footprint b x L, x 0 ... recess end; sigma = Fz/A + 6|My|/(b L^2) + 6|Mx|/(L b^2) (tension only); tau = |Fxy|/A + |Mz| r_max / J; R = sigma/sigma_a + tau/tau_a; design = limit x SF x k_fit x k_print; crash: m_group n_c g any axis at the group CG (A3 roll-up items + heaviest pack at the most forward station), no further factor

nodes.title: Pack stops: aft stop wall (+x), forward stop (-x)
nodes.equation: F_design = max over cases of the pack force x SF x k_fit x k_print; crash F = C1 85 N; sigma = 6 F (pad + h/2) / (b t^2) aft (pack bears from the pad top to the stop top), 6 F (h/2) / (b t^2) fwd (block on the tray); b = bay + 2 guides; fuse load of the forward stop F_f = sigma_a b t^2 / (6 h_f / 2); t_req = sqrt(6 F h/2 / (b sigma_a)); nose wall (foam board) as a strip between the side walls: M = F/4 (S - c/2), m_cap = sigma_f t_f (t - t_f) per unit width over the pack height

nodes.title: Bay guides (+-y) and strap legs in a lateral crash
nodes.equation: q = F / L_pack on the guide, resultant at h/2: sigma = 6 q (h/2) / t^2; overturn about the far guide top: T_legs = F (z_pack/2 + pad - h) / w_bay, per strap = T_legs / n

nodes.title: Straps (+z): loop tension, hook-and-loop overlap, tray and floor under the strap
nodes.equation: per strap P = max(F_flight x SF x k_fit x k_print, F_crash) / n; leg T = P/2 + preload/(2n); overlap_req = T / (tau_hl w); tray flat-wise = P / (w_tray (w + 2 s)); front strap on the overhang: floor-to-wall glue line q = P / (2 (w + 2 s)), stress = q / t_board (as drawn) or q / (t_board + fillet leg) with C6's corner fillet (CR-C6-17)

nodes.title: Pod overhang ahead of the wing LE: section at x = 0
nodes.equation: M = n g [m_pack,ahead x_bar + sum m_i |x_i|] (pack uniform over its length at the forward stop); section = foam-board faces only: 2 side walls (2 faces t_f x h_w) + floor bottom face (strap groove cuts the top face); tray left out (strap slot at x 0); sigma_top = M c / I

nodes.title: Carry handle on the spar (G1, whole aircraft at 2 g)
nodes.equation: F = m_gate g n_h x SF x k_fit x k_print; ties: F vs n x rating; grip: uniform hand load over the leg span s = 2 y_leg, M = F s / 8, sigma = 6 M / (b h^2)

nodes.title: Hatch suction at VD
nodes.equation: F = |Cp| q_VD A_hatch x SF x k_fit; aft half on the hook-and-loop tab: sigma = F/2 / A_tab

nodes.title: Pod mass: C3 sizing against D2's model, and the full-section forward stop option
nodes.equation: dm = rho [(t_aft,rec - t_aft,D2) h_a b + (t_fwd,rec - t_fwd,D2) h_f b + 2 (t_g,rec - t_g,D2) h_g L_bay]; m = CL-D2-MASS + dm; full-section option (CR-C5-13): + rho t_fwd b (H_bay - h_f)

nodes.title: Nose-in crush path with the D-47 nose (8.8 mm nose stack, block A ~1 mm)
nodes.equation: L_A = (x_fs - t_fs) - (x_le + t_b) ; per pack m (503/550/680 g): F = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_bay), KE = m v^2/2, eff = eps_d - eps_y/2 ; block A energy E_A = min(F, sigma A_stop) eff L_A, share = E_A/KE ; block B gap penalty of a stop of height h_f vs the full section = (min(F, sigma A_bay) - min(F, sigma h_f b_bay)) L_A / F ; same at the D2-R3/R4 block A (ASM-D2-FWD-STOP[0]) for comparison ; stack = t_b + L_A + t_fs

nodes.title: FEA verification of the pod load path (SU2 ELASTICITY, 4 mesh levels)
nodes.equation: bond design R = R_hand(full 3-D row) x R_FEA,in-plane / R_hand,in-plane (FEA concentration factor on the hand calc's Fz, My, Fx part; d0-averaged peaks); bond crash R = max over +-x, +-z of R_FEA (d0); overhang = wall-top face stress E_f exx at x = 0 (section fit); stops: peak principal stress at the root fillet, tray bending peak, board flat-wise peel (paper face to core, 2 mm mean), per variant

nodes.title: Aft-stop strut to the handle foot bridge (CR-C3-14 fix)
nodes.equation: rib bearing sigma = F / (n t h); Euler per rib (pinned, conservative) pi^2 E (h t^3 / 12) / L^2, x n; bridge: F vs the 2 spar ties (+x along the spar); mass = rho (n t h L + w_p h t_p)

nodes.title: Bond coupons: epoxy on F-250 and on paper-faced board
nodes.procedure: Build epoxy, 24 h cure. Three 50 x 50 mm PETG pads on F-250 offcut and three on board: flat-wise pull to failure (spring scale or luggage scale). Three 25 x 50 mm lap shears on F-250. Record failure load and mode (foam / paper / adhesive). Allowable = mean - 2 s, foam or paper failure required.

nodes.title: Printed stop wall and guide push test
nodes.procedure: Print the tray rear piece (with the strut on a handle-bridge offcut) and the tray front piece, same settings as flight, and epoxy each to a foam-board floor offcut as built (the FEA shows the board peel governs, so a bare tray proves nothing). Push a 50 x 50 mm block at 16 mm above the tray to 90 N (aft, +x) and at 13 mm to 85 N (forward, -x, with the 1 mm bed and a nose-wall offcut), 85 N spread over 60 mm (guide); no crack, no board delamination, set < 0.5 mm. Then to failure once.

nodes.title: Built pod on the wing: proof loads with a 680 g dummy pack
nodes.procedure: Wing on its spar ends. Dummy pack (680 g, pack size) strapped in. Pull the dummy pack with a luggage scale at 1.5 x the design value to the slowest-failing direction: down (overhang) 64 N, up 85 N, aft 85 N, sideways 85 N, 10 s each; inspect the bond edges, nose and wall tops for creases.
